entries.name: backend starts and becomes healthy (prerequisite for Electron to load real content)

3. real assets load (mode selector populated from the live backend)
4. backend connection resolves correctly (file:// -> http://127.0.0.1:3000)
5. no API request targets file://

8. real streaming starts (Stop control appears)

a full real chat round-trip completes (real backend, real OpenAI)
